obsidian.$description: Obsidian — Primary text, wordmark fills, link text, all heading color — the only non-white pigment in the interface

paper.$description: Paper — Page canvas, card surfaces, inverse text on dark moments

terracotta.$description: Terracotta — Sole chromatic accent — warm earthen tone for hover states, active indicators, or single-element highlights against the monochrome field

monument.$description: Sole typeface across the entire system. Regular variant at 13–23px for nav links, metadata, body micro-copy. Medium variant at 216px for the hero wordmark — the only element that earns the 216px scale, with -0.033em tracking to tighten the ultra-condensed letterforms into a continuous bar of black
